newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor stalemated by row over settlements.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor stalemated by row over settlements.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery was untraded for the fourth consecutive day on Wednesday as a deadlock over the settlement of dues by bull operators to bears continued, dealers said.
"Last week prices dropped sharply. Now some bull operators are not honouring payment towards bears," one dealer said.
Bombay Oil Exchange president Navin Chandra Shah said, "Officials of the Bombay Oil Exchange are busy trying to solve the deadlock and market may commence trading shortly."
Overall sentiment for castorseed was subdued in the absence of overseas enquiries and rising new crop arrivals.
New crop arrivals in Gujarat rose to 40/45 thousand bags (75 kg each). Groundnut oil was steady at 339/340 rupees per 10 kg in limited activity.

Imported palm-oil moved up by 2/3 rupees at 281/282 rupees per 10 kg on shortage of ready stock following absence of fresh arrivals at Bombay port. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil fell by 2/3 rupees to 511/512 rupees per 15 kg.
